@sketch
Feature: Rectangle center

  @acceptance @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-01 Commit the intended result
    Given the MCAD Software is running
    And an editable planar sketch
    When the user select Two Point Center Rectangle, choose a center, then a corner outside the input HUD
    Then the rectangle is centered on the first point and includes the observed diagonal construction geometry
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns with the rectangle and construction diagonals retained

  @documented_observation @edge_case @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-02 Select a corner after clicking a dynamic input field
    Given Two Point Center Rectangle is active in an editable sketch
    And a center has been selected and the command requests a corner
    When the user click a dynamic input field
    Then no rectangle is committed and corner selection remains active
    When the user click a distinct corner outside the input fields
    Then a rectangle with construction diagonals is committed
    And the command requests another center




  @cancel @documented_observation @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-06 Cancel after setting the center
    Given an editable sketch is Ready
    When the user select Two Point Center Rectangle and click its center
    Then the prompt changes to Select corner and two size fields appear
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns without a new rectangle or construction diagonals

  @documented_observation @edge_case @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-07 Recover a corner coincident with the center
    Given the command has accepted the center at a chosen location
    When the user click the identical location as the corner
    Then Select corner remains and both size fields show zero
    And no error dialog appears
    When the user click a distinct corner outside the dynamic input HUD
    Then the rectangle and diagonal construction geometry are committed
    And the prompt returns to Select center

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @undo_redo
  Scenario: rectangle-center-08 Restore centered rectangle and construction geometry
    Given a mouse-created centered rectangle
    When the user press Escape and then Ctrl+Z
    Then its sides and construction diagonals disappear
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the sides and construction diagonals return

  @documented_observation @needs_fixture @numeric_input
  Scenario: rectangle-center-09 Create a centered rectangle with two typed sizes
    Given Ready with a mouse-created rectangle
    When the user start Two Point Center Rectangle and select center at a chosen location
    And the user press 8, Tab, 4, and Enter separately
    Then a rectangle with size annotations 8 and 4 is committed
    And the command returns to Select center
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns and the committed rectangle remains

  @documented_observation @measurement @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-10 Verify full sizes of the numeric rectangle
    Given the numeric centered rectangle
    When the user open Measure and select its adjacent vertical and horizontal sides as Curves
    Then their lengths are 8.000 mm and 4.000 mm
    And the included angle is 90.00 degrees and minimum distance is 0.000 mm
    When the user click Done
    Then Measure closes without changing the rectangle

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-11 Observe zero in the first size field
    Given the recorded fixture sketch is Ready
    When the user choose Two Point Center Rectangle and select the fixture center
    And the user enter 0 and press Tab
    Then the first size is locked at 0.000 mm and the second field is selected
    When the user enter 4 and press Return
    Then the command requests Select center without a warning or visible new rectangle
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns with no visible new sides or diagonals

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-12 Observe zero in the second size field
    Given the previous sketch geometry is retained at Ready
    When the user start a fresh Two Point Center Rectangle and select the fixture center
    And the user enter 4 and press Tab
    Then the second field briefly displays a pointer-derived 0.368 mm preview
    When the user replace that field with 0 and press Return
    Then the command requests Select center without a warning or visible new rectangle
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns with the previous geometry retained

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-13 Create a six-by-four centered rectangle
    Given the recorded fixture sketch is Ready
    When the user start Two Point Center Rectangle and select the fixture center
    And the user enter 6, press Tab, enter 4 and press Return
    Then the rectangle shows vertical 6 and horizontal 4 with construction diagonals
    When the user press Escape
    Then Ready returns

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-14 Compare center and opposite corner coordinates
    Given the recorded 6-by-4 centered rectangle is retained
    When the user open Measure and select the center
    Then its Point coordinates are (0,-17.513,4.675) mm
    When the user click empty canvas to clear the selection
    And the user select the upper-left corner
    And the user select the opposite lower-right corner
    Then their Point coordinates are (0,-14.513,6.675) and (0,-20.513,2.675) mm
    And the corner distance is 7.211 mm with displayed component differences 0, 6 and 4 mm
    And the opposite-corner arithmetic midpoint equals the measured center at displayed precision

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-15 Undo and redo numeric creation
    Given Measure is closed and the numeric rectangle is retained
    When the user press Ctrl+Z
    Then its sides, construction diagonals and size dimensions disappear
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then the rectangle and its annotations return

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-16 Cancel a proposed height edit
    Given the retained centered rectangle has a driving height dimension equal to 6 mm
    When the user open its height annotation, enter 8 and press Escape
    And the user reopen the annotation
    Then the height editor still contains 6 mm

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-17 Accept height and observe the unfixed center move
    Given the height editor is open with 6 mm selected
    And the earlier measured center is (0,-17.513,4.675) mm
    When the user enter 8, press Return and exit General Dimension
    Then the top edge and diagonal intersection move upward visibly
    And the bottom edge remains visibly in place
    When the user open Measure and select the center point
    Then Measure reports center Point (0,-16.513,4.675) mm
    And its Y coordinate has increased by 1.000 mm at displayed precision
    When the user clear the selection and select the vertical edge
    Then the selected vertical Curve length is 8.000 mm
    And width annotation 4 and construction diagonals remain visible

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: rectangle-center-18 Undo and redo the accepted centered height edit
    Given Measure is closed after accepting height 8
    When the user press Ctrl+Z
    Then height annotation 6 and the shorter shape return
    When the user press Ctrl+Y
    Then height annotation 8 and the taller shape return
    And the center-marker location changes with the shape while width annotation 4 remains
